verdict.rationale: Unit is a financial infrastructure API platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint. The llms.txt file, OpenAPI spec, Postman collection, sandbox and webhooks are adjacent developer building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
